justification:
Milestone 021 re-baseline. Only the popover entry moved; listbox is byte-identical and select and combobox stayed inside the 10% ceiling. Three popover metrics needed a new baseline.

cssRawBytes 3958 -> 4503 and cssGzipBytes 949 -> 1154 are the popover.css restructure. The shared [popover] base was a popover box that Hover Card and Tooltip inherited, so a tooltip picked up `overflow: auto`, `overscroll-behavior: contain`, a `max-block-size` of nearly the viewport, and the panel's leading, then overrode part of it back. It is now a frame plus two per-component boxes, with the tooltip scoped out of the panel rule rather than layered over it. Before re-baselining, 537 gzipped bytes of block comments were cut from the new rules to match the rest of src/css, which ships essentially comment-free and unminified; that was 96% of the original overage. The 205 gzipped bytes left are the new rules themselves.

gzipBytes 4730 -> 5276 is mostly the chunk split this metric is known to track, not payload. Seven private copies of two feature detects became src/capabilities.ts, so tsdown emits capabilities-*.js as a fifth popover chunk and the summed per-module figure absorbs another chunk's gzip overhead. Concatenating the same closure gzips to 4595 against milestone 019's recorded 4205, a 9.3% rise, under the ceiling the summed figure breaches. The residual is real: the shared chunk carries all three probes, so a popover-only entry now ships supportsNativeDialog and supportsInvokerCommands unused. They are side-effect-free named exports, so a consumer bundler shakes them out; only the dist artifact carries them. popover rawBytes grew 8.0% and stayed inside the ceiling.

Re-recorded from the current build so every entry, including the three that did not grow, is guarded at its present size.
